prompt: You're debugging the search backend of a distributed autocomplete service. It builds a simple in-memory inverted index, but users report that searching for the term "Redis" returns an empty result set even though a document containing that exact word was definitely indexed — and critically, no error or exception is thrown anywhere. Other single-word lowercase queries return correctly. Walk through the indexing code and the query code below, pinpoint exactly why recall silently collapses to zero for this query, and explain why the absence of an exception is itself the key clue.
